story.originalTitle: Lance will miss media day today as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. He is recovering well, and we are confident he...
story.summaryEn:
Lance will miss media day today as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. He is recovering well, and we are confident he will return to the paddock on Friday.
#BrazilGP
detailZh:
Lance今天将缺席媒体日，因为他正在从在墨西哥感染的一种病毒中恢复。他的恢复情况良好，我们相信他将在周五回到维修区。
#巴西大奖赛
detailEn:
Lance will miss media day today as he continues to recover from a viral infection contracted in Mexico. He is recovering well, and we are confident he will return to the paddock on Friday.
#BrazilGP
